an5.126:1.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave dhammā anāyussā. Katame pañca? Asappāyakārī hoti, sappāye mattaṃ na jānāti, apariṇatabhojī ca hoti dussīlo ca pāpamitto ca. Ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā anāyussā.
an5.126:2.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave dhammā āyussā. Katame pañca? Sappāyakārī hoti, sappāye mattaṃ jānāti, pariṇatabhojī ca hoti sīlavā ca kalyāṇamitto ca. Ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā āyussā ti. CXXVII.
